title: CuPCR SARS-Cov-2
author: B Ronacher
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bpqwmmxe
materials: 00:30:00 RNA / DNA extraction Kingfisher Flex 96 (RNA / DNA extraktor, Thermo Fisher Scientific, 5400630, RNA/DNA extraktor processing up to 96 samples in a single run.) 100µl eluation buffer (e.g. water) containing RNA / DNA from the sample

steps.title: Prepare mastermix
steps.instruction: Combine 5 µL of primer mix with 5 µL of enzyme mix for each sample to make the RT‑PCR mastermix.

steps.title: Add sample to reaction
steps.instruction: Dispense 10 µL of the prepared mastermix into a PCR tube and add 10 µL of sample eluate, yielding a 20 µL reaction volume.

steps.title: Program thermal profile
steps.instruction: On the qTower3 instrument, select or program the RT‑PCR protocol: 2 min at 50 °C, 2 min at 95 °C, then 45 cycles of 5 s at 95 °C followed by 1 min at 60 °C with fluorescence scan, and a final hold at 25 °C. Total run time is 01:20:00.

steps.title: Load tubes and start run
steps.instruction: Place the PCR tubes into the qTower3, load the samples, and initiate the run.

steps.title: Analyze amplification curves
steps.instruction: After the run, examine the amplification curves for the human control, N‑gene, and RdRp‑gene of SARS‑CoV‑2. The human control is valid if its Ct is present. A Ct > 0 for the N‑gene or RdRp‑gene indicates a positive SARS‑CoV‑2 result.
